messages.subject: Switchboard NXT - XML multilayer corpora
parts:
For my current project, I will be using Switchboard NXT and I have a
feeling that I might be happier using R instead of the NITE XML
toolkit it comes with. However, I would have to start writing the
appropriate script from scratch. So I was wondering whether anyone
here has any experience in using R for corpus searches/n-gram
calculations in Switchboard NXT or any other XML formatted multilayer
corpus. I would be grateful for literature suggestions, tips and
tricks or even a peak at a script to get an idea of how best to handle
the data.

Any suggestions will be greatly appreciated.

Thanks.

Ulrike Schneider
